fields.description:
Sauna is back! Compared to my first hack this one has more levels, more chocolate, more secrets, more silliness, and it’s probably a bit more difficult. My goal was similar: to keep levels intuitive and fun, but I let myself get a bit crazier with level themes and ideas.

There are some secret exits with hints that will guide you in the right direction, though they aren’t that hard to find even without the hints. Also, portrait rooms are back for people who enjoy looking around for secrets.

Get comfortable, grab your chilled beverage of choice, and get ready for löyly. I hope you’ll have a good time!

Cover art made by Dangil, tracklist and changelog are included.
SNES Classic compatibility version is available in my filebin.

Version 1.0 - November 30th, 2024
Version 1.1 - February 5th, 2025
Version 1.2 - February 25th, 2025
Version 1.3 - January 5th, 2026

data.name: Mario's Misadventures 2: The Black Hole Bomb

fields.description:
Following from Mario's Misadventures: The Secret of The 11 Gems, Mario enters the black hole to stop the explosive device, discovering a strange new world inside. What is going on here? Where is the explosive device? As he explores the black hole, he starts to find clues about Bowser's whereabouts and a few artifacts from the Aquarians. Why did Bowser go to war with the Aquarians? Who else could he be working with? Can our hero locate and defuse the bomb before it goes off and destroys everything?

Standard
Kaizo with a mushroom
Jolly little trolls
Sports

Read about the song list and some of the relevant patches HERE.

fields.description:
After the events of Mario Quits, Peach and Mario live the perfect life at Peach’s Castle, but Mario feels there is something wrong. Follow him on his search for truth.

Mario Quits 2, like its predecessor, is a hack full of action, tight platforming and precision elements. It features fresh set-ups, inventive as well as classic levels, beautiful graphics and a ton of pixel art to tell an epic story.

The difficulty is definitely in the higher intermediate range. This game is difficult, but sections are relatively short.

27NOV2025 - v1.2
Changed a lot in the second section of "Turtle Timing Torture". It was too much torture. Some more indication. Corrected a typo or two.

21AUG2025 - v1.1
Since all hacks are getting remoderated at the moment, I take the chance and provide an update to MQ2. I nerfed some of the most difficult setups and added some indicators here and there. I explicitly want to mention that I nerfed the very first obstacle. So, a few people might want to try again.

fields.description:
Celebrate the season with Marios Christmas Adventure 2, a Beginner Kaizo hack that serves as a platforming Advent calendar. There are five levels in total, marking the four Advents and the Grand Finale on Christmas Day.

The difficulty is tailored to be beginner-friendly, focusing on fun platforming rather than frustration. You will encounter classic winter tropes mixed with creative setups, taking you from the bottom of a snow-covered plain all the way up to a frantic toy factory. Grab your controller and enjoy this festive treat!

fields.description:
This is the 2.0 beta of SMW Mix. This adventure brings us many Mario titles, both past and present, while respecting the graphic style of Super Mario World. An adventure filled with new power-ups that will give you tons of fun in each level, bosses from different installments, and beautiful graphics.

This beta is a showcase of all my work to date, with four open worlds and levels for you to freely explore. This hack is only available because it's a beta; everything will be locked in the final version. The hack is currently in Spanish; an English version will be available soon. If you find any bugs, please let me know so I can try to fix them.

That's all, have fun!

fields.description:
This hack is sort of a tribute to JUMP, and other JUMP Team hacks. It's mostly standard with a bunch of gimmicks and ASM things. Collecting Dragon Coins and 3-UP Moons will unlock some extra levels. Some levels may be considered somewhat kaizo, as this hack also draws inspiration from some of Morsel's hacks (there are a few required enemy bounces and unforgiving obstacles). A few puzzles will also be present that may require slightly advanced knowledge of game mechanics. Several of the more difficult levels will use the Retry system.

Update v1.1 as of 2025-07-17:
- Fixed the alternating blocks
- Fixed some other jank
read changelog.txt for all changes.

data.name: Mario and Luigi in an Unknown Island

fields.description:
Finally, after 5 years of having the pending to finish this project, I can say that I am happy to have finished and uploaded this project.
The story is the same but the ending is something that I did not raise at the time of starting, I simply had the consideration that the protagonists reach an end point without further ado, but in the development I decided to leave a doubt in the events, but that is not resolved at this time.
There have been some changes in aesthetics and gameplay:
*I have incorporated bosses in each final castle, I had the idea of not having them, but that decision was an act of laziness.
*I have modified the behavior of some sprites to enrich the game.
*The messages that were given in each level in the message boxes were a funny decision since most of them were not useful and also silly since in the beginning of the project I didn't think seriously about the story, in the last parts of the game the messages would be more formal and even something suggestive, but that's a secret surprise of the final story.
*Some decisions about the colors and graphics may be diverse and shocking, but this project did not have a consecutive follow-up and my skills were changing over time.
I must also say that I never planned to finish but I got motivated at the last moment because I didn't want to leave one of several pending I have.
I hope you like it.

data.name: Super Mario World: Legend of the Four Keys

fields.description:
An all-consuming void threatens to destroy the Mushroom World. Only 4 Legendary Keys have the power to stop it. It's up to Mario and Luigi to find these Keys before the world is destroyed.

In this hack, there are four themed Zones which you can play in any order a la Super Mario Land 2. Difficulty should be comparable to official Mario games (aside from Lost Levels).

UPDATE: I added a wall to the leftmost side of room 2 in the final level and placed the Yoshi at Mario's spawn point rather than in a ? Block.

fields.description:
This is a hack vaguely inspired by Nonsense and by the completely insane stories that game mods usually come up with to justify the plot.
It features a lot of custom sprites & blocks (thanks to the BLDC2 baserom) and short-ish levels and worlds, as well as a more forgiving system for taking damage.
(There's a "hard mode" patch included that makes the hit system work like normal SMW, too)
I had lots of fun making this hack, and hope it's as fun to play!

Also it's been updated to 1.1.1 now, fixing some minor but very visible oversights.

-plot-
Mario wants to go to the store.
However, he doesn't know that he's going to go through Heaven and Hell, the top of the tallest mountain, the depths of the sea, and the fifth dimension. And also prevent the end of the world as foretold by the Mayan prophecy of 2012.

data.name: Super Mario 16: The Fall of Yoshi

fields.description:
Super Mario 16: The Fall of Yoshi 1.54

Plot Overview:
The peaceful world of the Yoshis is in grave danger. Bowser has discovered the secret location of the last Yoshi egg, which contains the final Yoshi capable of saving their species from extinction. To prevent this, Mario must embark on a daring adventure across new lands, battling Bowser’s minions and solving puzzles to retrieve the egg before it’s too late.

Story Setup:
The Yoshis once lived in harmony with Mario, providing aid and companionship in his many quests. But after Bowser’s last attack, most of the Yoshi species have mysteriously vanished. The last Yoshi egg, hidden deep within the perilous, ever-changing Yoshi Island, is said to be the only hope for restoring the Yoshi race.

Mario learns of this egg's location from a distressed Toad, who reveals Bowser's evil plan to destroy it and rid the world of the Yoshis forever. Now, Mario must travel through uncharted lands, from volcanic mountains to underwater caves, and face off against new and old enemies to secure the egg and bring the last Yoshi back into the world.

Main Objective:

Find the Yoshi egg before Bowser and his army can destroy it.

Finally my hack is ready! For C3
Enjoy my latest romhack!


FOR SNES CONSOLE GAMERS NOTE:
THIS HACK HAS A SAVERAM ON 128 KB, MAKE SURE YOU HAVE A SNES EVERDRIVE THAT SUPPORTS 128 KB SAVERAM FILES

fields.description:
Super Mario Yggdrasil is a SMW hack with the soul of an RPG
Join Mario and his allies on a journey to save the kingdom of Midgard from the Fimbulwinter. Face bosses, solve puzzles, and uncover the personal stories of each team member.

What you need to know before playing:
1 - This hack is story-focused, much like classic RPGs, so there’s a lot of dialogue — but 98% of the story is optional, for those who prefer to focus on gameplay.
2 - The stages are quite long, so you might die near a save point and have to backtrack a good distance.
3 - If those two points aren’t an issue for you, you’re sure to enjoy this journey through Midgard. For the best experience, visit Midgard Castle in-game — there you'll find important information about the hack.

The ZIP file includes both English (ENG) and Portuguese (PT-BR) versions.
If you make a gameplay video or a post, use the hashtag: #SuperMarioYggdrasil

fields.description:
Back when the first BLDC came out, I thought I'd use the BLDC baseROM to make something Kaizo, which proved kinda restrictive in some ways. It makes use of the various custom power-ups and resources used in this baseROM (tho I have not used all of them even tho earlier on I was kinda thinking about it).
Difficulty and design philosophy kinda feels to me like a transition period between the design style I used to usually prefer that is played and tested with slowdown and savestates with consecutive precise mini-puzzles, and embracing tool-less ideology (I had started MMDLite/Zero/Remix during the home stretch of this hack's development). I got to a point where I just wanted to finish what I started and not look back.

fields.description:
In this metroidvania style hack, Peach has been kidnapped once again, but this time, not by Bowser. To be strong enough to rescue her, you'll need to explore the world to find some powerful power-ups, use those new skills to travel through dangerous paths and find hidden areas to reveal secret passwords.

Featuring:
- Health system
- Permanent power-ups
- Many custom graphics, music and sprites
- Every level is connected so there are 0 exits
- The equivalent of approximately 20 levels
- Lots of secret rooms
- One bonus room with a light kaizo level challenge


UPDATES:
V1.4
I wasn't planning to make any more changes, but since a section was frequently causing a softlock, I felt it was important to address it. While I was at it, I also took the opportunity to make a number of small improvements across various sections. See Changelog.txt for more info..
This will likely be my final update on this hack.

-------------------

V1.3
The main reason for this update was to rework the last level that was a little bit too hard and had a glitch that kills Mario for no reason.
I also fix a few other things that were bothering me.

-------------------

V1.2:

Following many comments received, I modified the end to make it a little less anticlimactic by adding NPCs and a whole new level.

For more details, check Changelog.txt

fields.description:
Jigoku Mario World 3 is the final entry of the Jigoku series, a series that started 10 years ago. It features 25 exits of some of my hardest challenges of all time in a semi-open overworld that allows you to play the 4 main worlds in any order.

Regarding the difficulty, I am not holding back with this one. That doesn't mean that every level is as hard as possible, but that I'm not removing any setups just because they could be too hard for some people, which I've always done in my previous hacks.

Despite the very high difficulty, I hope you'll have a ton of fun playing it.

You can find Videos of the levels here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLlXdZrV9Ur-2pyCM4Ax1uVrzZYqRNDvIp

fields.description:
Welcome to Mario & Friends' new adventure! Play as Mario, Luigi, Peach, Daisy, Wario, and Waluigi, each with their own special jumps and physics! Try to save the day before Kamek can complete his plans to erupt the Volcano!

- Each character has their own jump physics and special A-button jump/input: Mario spin jumps, Luigi ground pounds, Peach floats, Daisy flutters, Wario dashes, and Waluigi boosts!
- Each level has unique switching rules, designated by the signs at the start of each level. Some levels are solo adventures, some are free switching with the L and R button, and some are controlled by Kamek's switching bars!

This hack is a 21-exit standard adventure designed and completed in about a month and a half for Hackjam 2024. The first M&F hack was created during Hackjam 2021 (see it here if you'd like to check it out), and we were able to use that baserom as the basis for a full-scale adventure this time around!

This one is also a bit more difficult than the first, but still aimed to be beatable by very casual players :)

data.name: Jumping Over It with Super Mario

fields.description:
Jumping Over It with Super Mario is a "Getting Over It"-style experience. There's 3 levels
that you can play in any order, just beating any of the three means unlocking the
credits and beating the game:

jumping over it:
the main attraction of the hack and the most challenging level. highly inspired by
classics such as Carl Is Such A Nice Guy and Ultra Slope Muncher. You climb a
mountain and try to surmount the insurmountable. requires kaizo precision/knowledge
and a lot of patience

9 hole challenge:
a fun simple golfing challenge in super mario world. using the MOLF asm by
dtothefourth, mario turns into a golfball! saves after every hole. can you stay
under par?

notVANILLA SECRET 3:
mario has gained the power of commitment: he is committed to every single jump
and once he is in the air he is steadfast on keeping his trajectory. can you
overcome a somewhat familiar seeming breezy sea of dolphins?

I hope you enjoy this hack! Just make sure to bring a lot of patience.
Good Climbing!

fields.description:
A short 9 level (10 exit, with credits) hack that I made because I got fed up with messing around with my larger hack and had ideas for levels I didn't want to include in it. The hack is a mixture of vanilla and chocolate mechanics. While the focus was on platforming, there are shell and item tricks in many of the levels. I believe the hack sits squarely in the middle of intermediate difficulty but the creator is rarely able to tell how hard their creation is, so take that with a grain of salt!

There are a total of 3 block/key jumps, for people that hate those, and 4 unmarked kaizo blocks, for people who hate those. There are no secret exits or puzzles. There might be a few trolls as well...

Hopefully you enjoy playing the hack!

Version 1.1:
- Replaced some fish/dolphins in level 2 to remove some sporadic instances of lag.
- Updated a section of level 3 to make the intended path much more clear.
- Changed the second half of level 6 so that the setup at the very beginning is more intuitive.
- Fixed some aesthetic issues in level 8.
- Made what was intended in the first half of level 9 more clear.
- Removed some cheese in the second half of level 9 and made a setup more consistent.

Version 1.2:
- Added a message box in level 2 to explain how to stay on a disco shell in water.
- Added a muncher at the end of level 3 to remove some cheese.
- Disabled the down button in level 4 to prevent unintended duck jumps.
- Added some indication to level 8 and made some timings more lenient.
- Fixed some cheese in level 9 and prevented some strange sprite interactions.

fields.description:
- This hack has a non-linear structure, meaning you can play it in almost any order you want. Though, this does not mean you can skip immediately to the final level.

- There are both Standard and Kaizo levels, though some levels may blur the line. Difficulty ranges from Standard: Normal to Standard: Very Hard and Kaizo: Expert. This means that some levels are completable by beginners, while some levels will be a challenge even for the best players.

- There will be a lot of custom gimmicks and custom ASM in general.

Version 1.1: I apologise for updating this so soon, but
Significant Changes
-Fixed a bug at the end of The Moving Hills, where the layer 2 would move in strange ways.
-Fixed a janky jump at the end of Bullet Jumps of Absurdity.
-Fixed jank in Ice Barrier Tower by making koopas near the end immune to fireballs.
-Removed side exit in the fourth room in Bowser's Castle, where you could lose progress by reaching the autoscroll deathless.
-Fixed two mistakes in the in-game credits.
-Made first half of Cape Fusion slightly easier, and the second half somewhat more difficult to balance the difficulty, as the second half was trivial in comparison to the first.
-Improved indicators after the first checkpoint in Professional Platforming, and moved some saws after the second checkpoint.
-Added better indicators in the second room of Reflex, and added some sprite solid blocks to fix "jank".
-Balanced difficulty in the final level.
-Changed difficulty indicator graphics on the overworld to avoid confusion.
-Checkpoints before the final boss and postgame final boss will save to SRAM as long as you save on the overworld.

data.name: Mario's Misadventures: The Secret of The 11 Gems

fields.description:
The Aquarian Archipelago is a group of islands home to a strange secret involving 11 mystical gems held sacred by the native people. Mario receives a letter inviting him to this strange place, only to find it in disarray. What could be going on here? Is Bowser up to is dirty tricks again? As he explores the archipelago, he begins uncovering information about the gems and the fate of the natives. Can our hero solve the mysteries surrounding this place, learn the fate and allure of the gems, and restore peace and stability to the archipelago?

v1.1:
. Fixed the cutoff in the bonus game and the goal in Peaceful Plains 3
. Resolved the blind drops in Twisted Tundra 4, Lemmy's Castle, and Heavenly Heights 3

. Made a few level design changes in various levels

raw_fields.description:
The Aquarian Archipelago is a group of islands home to a strange secret involving 11 mystical gems held sacred by the native people. Mario receives a letter inviting him to this strange place, only to find it in disarray. What could be going on here? Is Bowser up to is dirty tricks again? As he explores the archipelago, he begins uncovering information about the gems and the fate of the natives. Can our hero solve the mysteries surrounding this place, learn the fate and allure of the gems, and restore peace and stability to the archipelago?

fields.description:
Welcome to SUPER MARIO LAND WORLD!

-STORY-

Mario has consumed a Subcon potion and fell into a deep slumber, where sarasaland has been invaded by the powers of subcon and the mushroom kingdom combined!
Save the day? Or perish in the land of dreams? the fate of the world is in the players hands.

- THINGS TO NOTE! PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE PLAYING! -
*Mario has different physics and speed in general, a floating higher spin jump and regular altered jump.
*Spikes are insta-death.
*13 Exits, based off of Mario land GB levels!
*Start with 10 lives, NO SAVES or Re-entering levels just like Mario land GB, the only save in the game is at the end of the quest. Thus making every moment count!
*This game is styled in black, white and shades of grey.
*The Yoshi coins are a collectible for earning your extra lives.
*There are secrets in SOME pipes, will you find them?
*The hack aims to mesh gb Mario land, SMW and all-stars style together.

-One final note-
This hack was submitted in 2023 and was rejected due to many reasons large and small.
I ended up not keeping the original base files and built off of the remaining rom that I had.
If I had the base files I could do tonnes more in the game itself, but at this point it wasn't worth backtracking, I hope what is here is good enough to have an enjoyable Mario experience!

With that said, thank you for playing and checking out my work, this is my first standard hack, I normally create beginner/lower intermediate kaizo! click on my name and browse for my work! check em out if you're wanting some wacky experiences.
If you want to report any major bugs or game breaking problems (In the unlucky event this happens) feel free to let me know in the comments!

*The current version is V1.1

Anyway, enjoy!

- Lush_50

fields.description:
So this hack has 8 Worlds and a Special World, and it's by far the biggest project I've made. There is a lot of custom ASM, sprites, bosses and such, just to keep it interesting. As for the difficulty, this hack is mainly recommended for experienced players. Nothing in the first worlds should be too difficult, but in later worlds and especially the Special World, some may struggle.

The original aim for this hack was to be what a harder, more gimmicky sequel to SMW could've looked like, though that became less of a focus as development progressed. The earlier worlds are most similar to vanilla. Obviously, however, the graphics rarely stray too far from the original SMW graphics.
